credits.title: There's A Roach Inside
credits.overview: A school principal is assaulted by surreal happenings.

credits.title: Ice Cream Man
credits.overview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

credits.title: Riff Raff
credits.overview: A retired hitman's life is turned upside down when his ex-wife and son arrive unannounced during the holidays because they are on the run from his former mob associates.

credits.title: Soul of A Sister
credits.overview: A singer with a once bright future falls victim to the music business at a young age. A decade later, despite an addiction and depression she rises up one more time with the help of a special friend and her God given gift of voice.

credits.title: Detachment
credits.overview: A chronicle of three weeks in the lives of several high school teachers, administrators and students through the eyes of substitute teacher Henry Barthes. Henry roams from school to school, imparting modes of knowledge, but never staying long enough to form any semblance of sentient attachment.
